tests.reason: The SUPPORTED status is justified by the chronology tied to the same tenant and premises. The appellant is stated to have entered the tenancy under the May 19, 1954 letting, and the challenged subletting is the subletting attributed to that appellant tenant in the later eviction proceeding. Because the statutory cutoff is June 9, 1952, a subletting by this tenant under that tenancy necessarily falls after the cutoff. The row correctly notes that the exact disposition date is not supplied and does not substitute the 1967 petition date for the disposition date.

The UNRESOLVED status is justified at the supplied Supreme Court stage. The Rent Controller and Appellate Tribunal finding of sub-letting is relevant support but remains a prior-court finding. The permitted excerpts do not identify the purported sub-tenant or supply the factual incidents that C02 says have to be found. With no supplied target-court adoption of those missing facts, the prior-court label cannot independently establish the literal test.
